annotations.title: ToolPick: Find the best paid API for a task

description:
Which paid API should my agent call? Searches the 36,000+ paid x402 resources on the public x402 discovery indexes and returns how many match your need, how many seller hosts there are, and the top 3 services ranked by relevance, 30-day unique payers and calls, recency and price (service name, USD price, networks, payers). Optional max_price and network filters. Free preview tier. The paid x402 routes add resource URLs and usage detail for the top 5 (/v1/lite), live 402 checks of the top candidates with a best verified pick (/v1/pick) and a market report with price quartiles and top sellers (/v1/market).

[ToolPick via YourAITools MCP Hub] Free tier: same as ToolPick's own MCP server (call without payment and without tier). Paid: lite $0.003 / pick $0.01 / market $0.02 per call, with a credits key (Authorization: Bearer yatc_...) or x402 (USDC; the hub returns the payment terms). Failed tool calls aren't charged: credits are refunded automatically and x402 payments only settle on success.

max_price.description: Only resources priced at or below this many USD per call, e.g. 0.01

min_payers.description: (paid calls only) Only resources with at least this many unique payers in the last 30 days (default 0)

need.description: The capability you need, in plain words, e.g. "solana token safety", "web search", "pdf to text", "hyperliquid funding rates" (2-200 chars)

network.description: Only resources payable on this network (default any)

tier.description: Paid tier: lite $0.003, pick $0.01, market $0.02. Omit tier (with no credits key or x402 payment) to use the free tier.
